msg: Hi, I did your mini course yesterday and loved it! Can I join the certified 2-dive trip tomorrow from Cartagena? I'm from Germany.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

I’m so glad you loved the mini course! The mini course doesn’t provide certification, so you’ll need a recognized certified-diver card to join the certified 2-dive trip. You can show it on the day or send a photo beforehand.

The trip from Cartagena is **USD 178 online** (regular price USD 197), with the 10% online discount applied automatically. The booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; since it’s now past that cutoff, tomorrow’s booking is no longer available online. You can book for the next available day here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.
